subject: how the momentum figure is built
body:
Momentum here is not one scrape. It is computed from repeated audience snapshots over a thirty day window, with a minimum baseline, a minimum gain, a floor and a ceiling on the percentage, and a staleness rule, so a list that stopped publishing stops counting. Lists that pass are tagged rising and ranked against each other.

The sponsor side has the same discipline. A placement is recorded with the evidence line from the issue, and a sponsor page carries its monthly placement history plus lookalike publications ranked by audience and cadence.

For a catalogue that has to defend its sources, the method is the product. I can send the rules and a sample of the output.
